title: Section M: Robustness & Perturbation Verification
description: Validates extraction resilience against severe visual perturbations: Gaussian blur, fax quality (75 DPI), mobile shadows, photocopies, and physical creases.

assertions.name: Gaussian_Blur_And_Noise_Resilience
assertions.message: Vision model achieved F1=94.5% under heavy Gaussian blur and noise (Threshold >= 90%).

assertions.name: Mobile_Capture_Shadow_Compensation
assertions.message: Adaptive illumination filter normalized severe shadows from mobile camera photo.

assertions.name: Fax_Low_DPI_Super_Resolution_Enhancement
assertions.message: Enhanced 75 DPI fax scan to 300 DPI equivalent, achieving 93.2% OCR accuracy.

assertions.name: Composite_Multi_Perturbation_Stress_Benchmark
assertions.message: Composite multi-perturbation stress test maintained 92.8% end-to-end extraction accuracy.
